writeup: Woot has the Steeltime Our Father prayer spinner ring in silver, size 8, for $4.99. It's stainless steel with a spinning band engraved with the Lord's Prayer, and it's hypoallergenic and nickel-free. Steeltime's own shop sells the same ring for $18 and Target lists it at $21.59, so this is about 72% less. Woot shows 10 left with a limit of 10 per customer.
